executive_phenotype_summary.text: The frozen E1 DEVELOPMENT evidence characterizes 381,527 lawful FVG formations across 7 native strata of XAUUSD (E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows). The lifecycle is governed by native bar counts, not wall-clock: median formation-to-first-touch is exactly 2 native bars at every stratum (p25 = 1 bar everywhere), and median formation-to-fill is 5-8 native bars (E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=*].formation_to_touch_market_ms, formation_to_fill_market_ms, converted to bars). Observed fill fractions decline from 99.55% (15s) to 84.43% (4h) in near lockstep with right-censoring rising from 0.45% to 15.57%; at coarse scales the fill fraction is a window-truncated lower bound, not a lifetime probability. A four-way path decomposition (touched-then-filled / touched-never-filled / filled-without-prior-touch / never-touched-never-filled) closes exactly at every stratum. Direction populations are near-balanced at fine strata (51.0% bullish at 15s) and drift to a bullish majority at coarse strata (60.5% at 4h). Prospective native closes show positive raw-return medians at all 21 stratum-horizon cells (consistent with development-window drift) while direction-adjusted medians are negative in 19 of 21 cells, growing in magnitude with horizon: a descriptive counter-directional median tendency that requires a formal null test before any further weight is placed on it. Anomalies are small and registered but not resolved here: 356 orphan fill events and 177 orphan touch events, fill-without-prior-recorded-touch at up to 0.83% of stratum formations (0 at 4h), known-time versus market-time divergences up to about 1 bar in both directions, and a 4h incidence uptick after a monotone decline. Overall the evidence is complete, internally consistent, and sufficient for phenotype synthesis; nothing blocks passage to synthesis.

cross_stratum_observations.statement: Formation incidence declines monotonically with scale from 21.60% (15s) through 11.87% (1h) and then ticks up to 14.29% at 4h (E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=*].formation_incidence.rate). The 4h uptick breaks an otherwise monotone pattern.

Median formation-to-first-touch is exactly 2 native bars at every stratum, and p25 is exactly 1 native bar at every stratum (E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=*].formation_to_touch_market_ms.p50/p25 divided by bar period; derived). In wall-clock this ranges from 30 s (15s) to 8 h (4h).

Median formation-to-fill is 7 native bars at 15s/30s/1m/5m, 8 bars at 15m/1h, and 5 bars at 4h; p75 is 30-34 bars at every stratum (E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=*].formation_to_fill_market_ms; derived). Lifecycle timing in the body of the distribution is approximately invariant in native-bar time across a 960x span of bar periods.

Touch p95 in bar units is 158-193 bars at 15s through 1h but only ~89 bars at 4h; fill p95 in bar units declines from ~717 (15s) through ~562 (15m), ~403 (1h) to ~170 (4h) (derived from E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=*].formation_to_touch_market_ms.p95, formation_to_fill_market_ms.p95). The coarse-scale tails are truncated, consistent with rising right-censoring (0.45% to 15.57%), not demonstrably with a genuine shortening of long lifetimes.

Observed fill fraction falls monotonically with scale: 99.55%, 99.36%, 99.10%, 97.77%, 95.99%, 92.16%, 84.43% (E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=*].fill_rate.rate); right-censored fraction rises monotonically: 0.45%, 0.64%, 0.90%, 2.23%, 4.01%, 7.84%, 15.57% (right_censored_rate.rate). The two gradients are near-complementary.

Bullish share of formations rises monotonically with scale: 51.03% (15s), 51.71% (30s), 52.44% (1m), 54.29% (5m), 57.98% (15m), 58.32% (1h), 60.48% (4h) (E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=*].bullish_n / (bullish_n + bearish_n); derived).

The four-way path decomposition (touched-then-filled = formed_touch_fill_n; touched-never-filled = first_touch_n - formed_touch_fill_n; filled-without-prior-touch = formed_fill_without_prior_touch_n; never-touched-never-filled = lawful_formation_n - first_touch_n - formed_fill_without_prior_touch_n) sums exactly to lawful_formation_n, and touched-never-filled + never-touched-never-filled equals right_censored_n, at all 7 strata (derived from E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=*]).

Both censored sub-populations grow with scale as a share of formations: touched-never-filled 0.209% (15s) to 9.581% (4h); never-touched-never-filled 0.237% (15s) to 5.988% (4h) (derived from E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=*]). At every stratum except 4h (61.5%), roughly 46-51% of censored zones were touched but never filled.

gap_atr p05 is pinned near the detector floor at every stratum (0.2205-0.2294, against min_gap_atr=0.2 in AP-002_AUTHORITY_V1.json.parameters) while the median declines from 0.5638 (15s) to 0.4543 (1h) and rises to 0.5266 (4h); p95 is U-shaped (1.62, 1.44, 1.34, 1.35, 1.48, 1.62, 1.60) (E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=*].gap_atr).
fvg_quality is nearly scale-stable: median 0.7974 (15s) to 0.7452 (1h), 0.7562 (4h); p05 0.479-0.501; p95 0.943-0.989 (E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=*].fvg_quality).

Orphan lifecycle events (touch/fill events with no formation payload counterpart in the stratum) total 177 touches and 356 fills; their burden per formation rises with scale: orphan fills are 0.069% of formations at 15s vs 3.593% at 4h (E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=*].orphan_touch_n, orphan_fill_n; derived).

Read together, X2/X3/X5/X4 indicate that the apparent scale dependence of the fill fraction is largely an observation-window effect in bar-time: the fill-time tail (p95 roughly 560-720 bars at fine/mid scales) is negligible against a ~1.05M-bar 15s window but is a large fraction of the 1169-bar 4h window. The evidence does not establish that coarse-scale zones are intrinsically less likely to fill.

The monotone bullish-share gradient (X6) may reflect development-window upward drift in XAUUSD interacting with bar aggregation, or session-structure effects at coarse bars, rather than a detector property. Testable later per stratum with a formal direction-balance null; no significance claim is made here.

prospective_response_observations.definition: Native closes 1, 3, 5 lawful bars after formation; raw and direction-adjusted returns in bps vs anchor_mid (E1_EXPERIMENT.json.prospective_response). Denominators are lawful_formation_n per stratum; n shortfalls are end-of-stream truncations.

observations.statement: Raw-return medians are positive at all 21 stratum-horizon cells and grow with horizon and with bar period: e.g. 15s h1 +0.012 bps to h5 +0.059 bps; 4h h1 +2.531 bps to h5 +25.980 bps (E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=*].horizons[*].raw_return_bps.p50).

Direction-adjusted medians are negative in 19 of 21 cells. Exceptions: 1h h3 (+0.852 bps, n=523) and 4h h5 (+12.508 bps, n=167). Magnitudes grow with horizon at every stratum except 5m h5 (-0.516) vs h3 (-0.553), and grow with scale in bps: h1 medians -0.000 (15s), -0.027 (30s), -0.075 (1m), -0.225 (5m), -0.455 (15m), -0.108 (1h), -1.134 (4h) (E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=*].horizons[*].direction_adjusted_return_bps.p50).

The raw-positive / direction-adjusted-negative split (P1/P2) reads as a drift confound plus a small counter-directional median tendency after formation: conditional on formation, the median native forward close moves opposite to the forming impulse direction, in both direction cohorts, at nearly all scales and horizons. This is a descriptive phenotype statement about medians only; the tails are wide and no null test has been applied.

Tails are wide and mostly near-symmetric in direction-adjusted space, with left-heavier tails at some coarse cells: 4h h1 p05 -124.45 vs p95 +84.10; 1h h1 p05 -55.33 vs p95 +49.53; while 1h h5 (p05 -104.65, p95 +125.69) and 4h h5 (p05 -278.56, p95 +282.74) are right-heavy or symmetric (E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=1h,4h].horizons[*].direction_adjusted_return_bps).

Dispersion scales with bar period as expected for returns: raw h1 p95-p05 span is ~6.4 bps at 15s, ~31 bps at 5m, ~113.6 bps at 1h, ~209.7 bps at 4h (E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=*].horizons[0].raw_return_bps p95 minus p05; derived). No anomalous scaling regime is apparent.

Sample sizes: full n at 30s/1m/1h/4h for all horizons; shortfalls only at 15s (h3/h5 n=227924), 5m (h3/h5 n=7139), 15m (h3 n=2191, h5 n=2189), each against the full lawful_formation_n denominator (E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=*].horizons[*].n and .denominator).

Register for later formal testing: (a) per stratum, whether direction-adjusted median at each horizon differs from zero (sign/permutation test); (b) whether the counter-directional median tendency intensifies per-bar with scale (h1 medians per bar: ~0 at 15s vs -1.134 bps at 4h); (c) whether the 4h h5 positive median survives given n=167; (d) whether left-tail weight at 1h/4h h1 differs from right-tail weight. None of these is established by this development evidence.

anomalies.name: fill_without_prior_recorded_touch
anomalies.statement: Fills with no prior recorded first touch exist at every stratum except 4h: 682 (15s), 213 (30s), 81 (1m), 20 (5m), 10 (15m), 4 (1h), 0 (4h) - up to 0.83% of stratum formations (E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=*].formed_fill_without_prior_touch_n). These are included in fill_n and fill_rate.
anomalies.interpretation: A mechanically possible explanation is a later bar that gaps entirely through the zone (no range overlap, hence no touch event) while its extreme reaches the fill edge - e.g. across session breaks/weekends - or same-bar touch/fill ordering semantics; the authority defines touch as range overlap and fill as far-edge reach (AP-002_AUTHORITY_V1.json.authoritative_semantics.first_touch, .fill). This cannot be verified from the frozen tables alone.
anomalies.status: requires explanation before any fill-anchored cohort is promoted

anomalies.name: orphan_lifecycle_events
anomalies.statement: 177 orphan touch events and 356 orphan fill events with no formation payload counterpart (E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=*].orphan_touch_n, orphan_fill_n). Formation payloads cover all 381527 zone identities, so these events reference identities outside the formed cohort tables or unreconciled state.
anomalies.interpretation: Plausible sources include detector-state serialization/restoration edges or availability-gated suppression of formation rows while lifecycle events still fired; not resolvable from the frozen tables. Orphans are already excluded from formed_* cohort counts, so headline fractions are not contaminated.
anomalies.status: requires scanner-author explanation before E1B cohort freeze; proportional burden is largest at 4h (3.593% of formations)

anomalies.name: known_time_vs_market_time_divergence
anomalies.statement: Known-time durations differ from market-time durations at upper quantiles: known is SHORTER by up to ~1 bar at 5m/15m fill p75, ~2 bars at 1m fill p95, ~1 bar at 1h fill p25 and touch p75, and ~4 bars at 1h fill p75 (104400134 vs 118800000 ms); known is LONGER by ~1 bar at 4h touch p75 (187199950 vs 172800000 ms) (E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=*].formation_to_fill_known_ms, formation_to_touch_known_ms vs market_ms). At fine strata all listed quantiles agree within sub-second to ~0.3 s.
anomalies.interpretation: Known <= market at upper quantiles is consistent with intra-bar knowability of the touching/filling extreme (bar-boundary market time overstates when the information existed). Known > market at 4h touch p75 is consistent with delayed receipt of bar completion across quiet or closed sessions. Both directions are availability-clock mechanics, not causality violations (SCANNER_INTEGRITY_GATE.json.checks prospective_response_causality PASS), but they mean lifecycle durations are clock-dependent and E1B anchors must declare their clock.
anomalies.status: registered; clock choice must be pre-registered for E1B

anomalies.name: incidence_uptick_at_4h
anomalies.statement: Formation incidence declines monotonically 21.60% -> 11.87% (15s -> 1h) then rises to 14.29% at 4h (E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=*].formation_incidence.rate).
anomalies.interpretation: With only 1169 4h bars (167 formations) the 4h estimate is imprecise; the uptick may be sampling noise or a genuine session-gap aggregation effect. Descriptive only.

anomalies.name: fill_fraction_exceeds_touch_fraction_at_15s
anomalies.statement: At 15s the observed fill fraction (99.554%) exceeds the first-touch fraction (99.463%) because 682 fills lacked prior touch while only 476 zones were touched and never filled (E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=15s].fill_rate.rate, first_touch_rate.rate; derived).
anomalies.status: arithmetic consequence of A1; flagged so the inversion is not misread as an inconsistency

anomalies.name: end_of_stream_response_shortfalls
anomalies.statement: Horizon n falls 1-3 short of denominator at 15s (h3/h5), 5m (h3/h5) and 15m (h3/h5), consistent with the authority rule that no synthetic tail bar is emitted (AP-002_AUTHORITY_V1.json.lawful_availability.end_of_stream) (E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=*].horizons[*].n).

censoring_cautions: Right-censored zones are active, unfilled zones at the final lawful native bar (SCANNER_INTEGRITY_GATE.json.checks right_censoring). Censoring is 0.45% (15s) to 15.57% (4h) of formations (E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=*].right_censored_rate.rate).

Observed fill fractions are window-truncated lower bounds on eventual fill behavior; they must never be read as hazards or lifetime probabilities. At 4h, fill p95 (~170 bars) is ~14.5% of the entire 1169-bar history, so the coarse-scale fill fraction is materially truncated (derived from E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=4h]).

The censored population is heterogeneous: at every stratum it splits into touched-never-filled (e.g. 16 of 26 at 4h) and never-touched-never-filled (10 of 26 at 4h) (derived from E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=*]). Any E1B design must keep these distinct; pooling them assumes they are the same phenotype, which is not established.
Censoring also truncates time-to-fill and time-to-touch upper quantiles at coarse scales (X4), so cross-stratum tail comparisons in bar-time are observation-limited, not necessarily behavioral.

Prospective responses are complete or near-complete (n shortfalls of 1-3 rows, A6), so response statistics are far less censoring-exposed than lifecycle-duration statistics; but 1/3/5-bar responses are fixed horizons and say nothing about longer horizons.

Development-data-only scope: all quantities are in-sample descriptions of XAUUSD_DATA_SCOPE_V1 DEVELOPMENT; no out-of-sample or confirmation inference is licensed (E1_EXPERIMENT.json.development_scope; confirmation_status LOCKED).

FIRST_TOUCH.justification: First touch is near-universal where observed (touch fractions 94.0%-99.5%) and occurs at median 2 native bars at every stratum, so a touch-anchored study yields large, fast-realizing cohorts at all scales, with the touched-never-filled population (476 at 15s down to 16 at 4h) as a built-in contrast class.
requirements: Cohort denominator per stratum = first_touch_n (E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=*].first_touch_n); never-touched zones excluded by construction and reported.
Pre-register the anchor clock (known-time vs market-time) given A3 divergences up to ~1 bar.
Pre-register treatment of filled-without-prior-touch zones (A1): they cannot enter a touch-anchored cohort; decide exclusion vs a separate cohort before freezing.
Keep touched-never-filled vs touched-then-filled distinct when interpreting later outcomes; censoring-heterogeneity caution applies.
Per-stratum analysis only; no cross-scale pooling; (timeframe, zone_id) identity only (AP-002_AUTHORITY_V1.json.identity).

FILL.justification: Fill cohorts are near-complete at fine/mid strata (fill fractions 97.8%-99.6% at 15s-5m) and fill is the cleanest zone-consumption event, but at 1h/4h the cohort is survivor-conditioned (92.2%/84.4% of formations with 7.8%/15.6% censoring), which must be registered as a selection caveat.
requirements: Cohort denominator per stratum = fill_n (E1_RESULTS.json.tables.strata.rows[tf=*].fill_n); report the censored complement explicitly.
Register the survivor-conditioning of coarse-scale fill cohorts (1h/4h) and any selection handling before freezing cohorts.
Pre-register anchor clock (A3) and the treatment of same-bar touch+fill pairs and of fill-without-prior-touch rows (A1).

Define the response grid strictly after the fill event's lawful availability; integrity gate confirms later-lawful-close responses are enforceable (SCANNER_INTEGRITY_GATE.json.checks prospective_response_causality).
Per-stratum analysis only; no cross-scale pooling.

shared_preconditions: Orphan events (A2) must receive a scanner-author explanation, and an exclusion/reconciliation policy must be fixed, before any E1B cohort freeze.
Both anchors require explicit right-censoring accounting and separate tracking of the two censored sub-populations (X8).
min_gap_atr=0.2 floor-pinning of gap_atr p05 (X9) means formations near the threshold may be a selected population; any E1B conditioning on gap_atr should account for threshold selection.

questions_for_question_generator: Q1: What mechanism produces the 177 orphan touch and 356 orphan fill events, and do they concentrate at detector-state restoration boundaries or availability edges? (Directs to scanner author; blocks E1B cohort freeze policy only, not synthesis.)
Q2: Are fill-without-prior-touch rows (682 at 15s ... 0 at 4h) gap-through bars across session breaks/weekends, and does their per-stratum rate track session-gap density?

Q3: Is the monotone bullish-share gradient with scale (51.0% at 15s to 60.5% at 4h) explained by development-window drift, session-aggregation asymmetry, or detector mechanics? Requires a formal direction-balance test per stratum.

Q4: Is the counter-directional median tendency in direction-adjusted returns (negative in 19 of 21 cells) a reversion-to-impulse artifact of the three-bar formation geometry (middle body >= 0.20 ATR) rather than a zone property? Testable against matched non-formation impulses later.
Q5: Does the 4h formation-incidence uptick (14.29% after a monotone decline to 11.87%) survive an interval estimate given n=1169 bars / 167 formations?
Q6: Which clock (known-time vs market-time) should define E1B anchors and horizon grids, given divergences up to ~1 bar in both directions (A3)?
Q7: Do touched-never-filled and never-touched-never-filled censored zones differ in gap_atr, fvg_quality, or formation context (censoring heterogeneity, X8)?

Q8: Does gap_atr p05 pinning at ~0.22 against the min_gap_atr=0.2 floor (X9) indicate a threshold-selected formation population, and should sensitivity near the floor be studied before any gap_atr conditioning is frozen?
claims_that_must_not_be_made: That any observed fill fraction is a hazard, lifetime probability, or the probability an FVG eventually fills; they are window-truncated descriptive fractions with material right-censoring at coarse scales.
That raw or direction-adjusted return patterns constitute an edge, alpha, profitability, predictive advantage, or any strategy-grade result; no null test has been run and confirmation is locked.
That strata are statistically interchangeable or may be pooled to raise N; every statement here is per-stratum.
That cross-scale zone identity exists; identity is (timeframe, zone_id) only and cross-scale identity is prohibited (AP-002_AUTHORITY_V1.json).
That the 4h bullish majority (60.48%) or the bullish-share gradient is a statistically established direction bias; it is a descriptive gradient awaiting a formal test.
That unfilled 1h/4h zones would or would not eventually fill, or that coarse-scale fill fractions are asymptotic.
That fill-without-prior-touch rows or orphan events are scanner defects; they are unexplained but not demonstrated to be errors.
Any causal claim that formation causes subsequent native returns beyond the descriptive, in-development-sample association recorded here.
Any transfer of these development-only quantities to E2/E3 contexts, confirmation, or live behavior.
That lifecycle-duration distributions are scale-invariant in full, including tails; only the body quantiles are approximately bar-time invariant, and coarse-scale tails are censoring-truncated.
overall_assessment_rationale: The frozen evidence is complete (zero unavailable counters, all 381527 zone identities reconciled to formation payloads), deterministic across two independent runs (identical logical hashes), integrity-gated on all nine checks including prospective-response causality and right-censoring handling, and internally consistent to the zone at every stratum (four-way lifecycle decomposition closes exactly). The phenotype questions posed for E1 - incidence, direction balance, lifecycle paths and timing, censoring, distributions of gap_atr/fvg_quality, and lawful prospective behavior at 1/3/5 bars - are all answerable from these tables. Registered anomalies (orphans, fill-without-prior-touch, clock divergences, 4h incidence uptick) are small, quantified, and do not contaminate cohort-level fractions; they are carried forward as questions, not blockers.
